title: ISRO's PSLV-C61 places all five satellites in target orbit; chairman calls mission 'textbook'
summary: ISRO successfully placed five satellites in target orbit using PSLV-C61 from Sriharikota on Friday morning, completing the agency's third commercial launch of the year. ISRO Chairman Dr. S. Somanath called the mission a 'textbook execution' and confirmed two more PSLV launches are slated for the current quarter. The mission included the first satellite from a Tier-2 city startup based in Bhubaneswar.

sentiment.rationale: Coverage emphasizes 'successfully placed', 'textbook execution', and 'first satellite from a Tier-2 city startup', all strongly favorable framings of the mission and the broader ecosystem.

The mission included the first satellite from a Bhubaneswar-based Tier-2 city startup.
